rules.statement: The burden of proving prescriptive title falls on the defendant where the legal title is in the plaintiff.
rules.supporting_quote: It is settled law that where the legal title is in the plaintiff the burden of proving prescriptive title falls on the defendant (Siyanaris Vs Jayasinghe Udeni De Silva 52 NLR 289, Juliana Hamine Vs. Don Thomas 59 NLR 546, Sirajudeen and two others Vs. Abbas 1994 (2) SLR 365).
